label: Fetch Page
description: Fetch one URL as clean markdown (JavaScript rendered, boilerplate stripped), ready for an LLM node. Uses Firecrawl. The markdown is cut at `maxChars` (50,000 by default), and shorter if it would still weigh more than the 100 KB a wire carries; `truncated` says when it was cut.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The Firecrawl access (wire a FirecrawlAccess node).

inputs.name: maxChars
inputs.label: Max characters
inputs.description: The most characters of markdown to keep; the rest of the page is cut off and `truncated` is true. Whatever you set, the markdown is also cut to fit the 100 KB a wire carries.

outputs.name: truncated
outputs.description: True when the page's markdown was longer than `maxChars` or than a wire carries, so `markdown` holds only its start.

then.message: FetchPage '{id}' has a `url` that is not a web address. Start it with http:// or https://.
